connector.notes: Adds the Godown summary: closing stock by the godown it is kept in. The app needs this connector version to show that report; everything else works as before, and nothing needs to be set up again.

android.notes: TallyFlow is now Prime Analyst. Same app, same account, same books - only the name and the icon have changed, and you stay signed in. New: a Summary tab with every month's sales, purchases, receipts and payments, a Godown summary report, and the sales card on Home opens the sales register for the period you are looking at. Profile has moved to the icon at the top left.
